title: Full research pass review of Italian local Mass-book uses, excluding Ambrosian
semantics: Review receipt for bounded witness evidence. Entries are not a count of physical books, independent recensions, authorized use, or substantive revisions.

review_files.storage: disposable .scratch evidence, pinned by SHA-256; no scratch path is a published source binding

uses.label: Aquileia
uses.finding: Eleventh-century missal and four printed dated witnesses are catalogued. The 1494 facsimile has exact bytes; 1508 and 1519 are independently identified bibliographically. Dated printings are not yet proved substantive textual states.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Compare Ordinary, Canon, temporal, sanctoral, rubrics, and Holy Week across 1494, 1508, 1517, 1519; identify authorities and earlier manuscript layers.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Compare Ordinary, Canon, temporal, sanctoral, rubrics, and Holy Week across 1494, 1508, 1517, 1519; identify authorities and earlier manuscript layers.

uses.label: Aosta
uses.finding: Amiet identifies 24 Ordinary witnesses, including later layers, and describes a fourteenth-century offertory revision and a 1617 substitution of the Roman Ordinary. The 1612 card remains underidentified.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Compare the 1617 and 1733 books against manuscript subuses and inspect original title, approbation and complete component scope.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Compare the 1617 and 1733 books against manuscript subuses and inspect original title, approbation and complete component scope.

uses.label: Benevento
uses.finding: VI 33 catalogue IDs 938, 1299, 6276 refer to one manuscript. VI 29 is former BL Egerton 3511; Ott. lat. 576 has dated parts. Script and notation are not proof of one Old Beneventan Mass text.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Acquire original manuscripts or facsimiles; map Latin prayers and chant strata separately; resolve unnamed missal entries and current VI 29 holding.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Acquire original manuscripts or facsimiles; map Latin prayers and chant strata separately; resolve unnamed missal entries and current VI 29 holding.

uses.label: Padua
uses.finding: The examined Usuarium Padua origin 899 Books table has pontificals and rituals but no Missal/Sacramentary/Gradual row. Padua D 47 is a Gregorian sacramentary with disputed production region, later Verona appendix and early Latin ownership; E 57 is an uncollated local order-book lead.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Inspect E 57 Eucharistic rubrics and local missal holdings; do not equate Pataviense (Passau) with Padua.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Inspect E 57 Eucharistic rubrics and local missal holdings; do not equate Pataviense (Passau) with Padua.

uses.label: Monza
uses.finding: In the examined Usuarium Monza origin 1103 table and named order-book bibliography, a Gradual, uncertain-origin sacramentary and homiliary are leads; no independent complete local Eucharistic recension is established within this searched range. Wider manuscript and text corpora remain unexamined.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Inspect Liber ordinarius Modoetiensis and exact Monza/Berengar sacramentary contents; separate Roman, Ambrosian and local ritual material.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Inspect Liber ordinarius Modoetiensis and exact Monza/Berengar sacramentary contents; separate Roman, Ambrosian and local ritual material.

uses.label: Ravenna
uses.finding: In the examined Usuarium Ravenna origin 929 table and Ravenna Rotulus/fragment cards, prayer components and unidentified fragments appear; no complete Ravenna Missal is established within this searched range. Wider manuscript corpora remain unexamined.
uses.limit: Catalogue entries are witness leads unless original text or an edition-specific scholarly comparison is identified. No complete all-component stage sequence certified.
next_sources: Identify each fragment, copying layer and provenance; compare Advent prayer corpus without inventing a complete annual Mass book.
uses.review_remaining_gap: Identify each fragment, copying layer and provenance; compare Advent prayer corpus without inventing a complete annual Mass book.
